fieldValues.title: Put a deterministic target-neutral IR between records and emitters
fieldValues.decision_rationale: Semantic interpretation must be shared before targets render it. A deterministic neutral intermediate representation prevents each backend from inventing incompatible meanings while preserving target-specific output mechanics.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Projection resolves semantic meaning into a target-neutral intermediate representation before any target back end renders it.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: - Let each target define an independent semantic interpretation.
fieldValues.accepted_costs: All emitters depend on a shared interpretation layer whose changes affect every target.
fieldValues.review_trigger: Review when a target requires semantic interpretation unavailable in the neutral IR, or when a proposed backend bypasses it.
